purpose: Meaning-preserving compaction of the seven highest-risk dialogue rows from the current screen-width audit.

records.source_jp: キサマごときにあのお方が倒せるものか！
records.before: 네놈　따위가　그분을　쓰러뜨릴　수　있을　것　같으냐！
records.after: 네놈　따위가　그분을　쓰러뜨릴　수　있겠느냐！
records.reason: Remove redundant Korean periphrasis while preserving the contemptuous rhetorical challenge.

records.source_jp: 怨恨のみで戦いを支える者に私は倒せぬ！
records.before: 원한만으로　싸우는　자가　나를　쓰러뜨릴　수는　없다！
records.reason: The omitted explicit subject 'one who fights' is already entailed by the sentence; the key claim that resentment alone cannot defeat the speaker remains intact.

records.source_jp: 私は貴様を倒し、己の甘さを清算する！
records.before: 나는　네놈을　쓰러뜨리고、　스스로의　나약함을　청산한다！
records.reason: Drop the context-redundant first-person pronoun and shorten the connective; both defeating the opponent and settling one's weakness remain explicit.

records.source_jp: そのためには命を失ってもよい覚悟なのです
records.before: 그러기　위해서라면　목숨을　잃어도　좋다는　각오입니다
records.reason: Compress the willingness construction to the natural Korean expression 'prepared to lose my life' without changing the resolve.

records.source_jp: 我らの力を認め、屈するに違いあるまい……
records.before: 우리의　힘을　인정하고、　굴복할　것이　틀림없다……
records.after: 우리　힘을　인정해、　틀림없이　굴복할　거다……
records.reason: Use a shorter colloquial connective while preserving recognition of our strength and certainty of surrender.

records.source_jp: 主義や主張ではなく平和を望む心です！
records.before: 주의나　주장이　아니라　평화를　바라는　마음입니다！
records.reason: Render the contrast as 'rather than ideology or assertions'; the central meaning, a wish for peace rather than doctrine, is retained.

records.source_jp: 持ちながら評価を受けぬものの苦しみは！！
records.before: 가지고　있으면서　평가를　받지　못하는　자의　괴로움은！！
records.reason: The preceding partner line already supplies the object 'power beyond humans'; '지니고도' naturally continues it and preserves the suffering of possessing it without recognition.
